source_row.rationale: Secondhand smoke exposure in children is associated with numerous adverse health effects, including increased risk of respiratory infections, asthma exacerbations, ear infections, and sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS), among other effects, underscoring the importance of maintaining smoke-free environments for children.
